{{/* Hero with superset markup across three orthogonal axes: data-hero (structure): none — copy only, centered; centered — single centered column, cover below; right — copy left, featured cover right (default); many — three overlapping covers data-hero-book: straight | 3d (how the featured cover renders) data-hero-bg: page | gradient | scrim | cover (blurred own art) | banner (site.json banner — the author's uploaded image) CSS in site.css shows/hides the pieces; hidden images are loading="lazy" so unused variants cost nothing until selected. Everything renders from the contract: site.json, author.json, books.json. */}} {{ $site := hugo.Data.site }} {{ $author := hugo.Data.author }} {{/* The hero content block (site.json hero — the SiteDesigner's element editor). hero.source picks what the copy says: author (default) — the author's name & bio excerpt featured — the featured book's title & description custom — the author's own headline & text (hero.headline / hero.lede; blank halves fall back to tagline/bio) hero.book picks the featured cover by slug. The action buttons render regardless of source. */}} {{ $hero := $site.hero | default dict }} {{ $featured := partial "featured-book.html" . }} {{/* The many-books covers: the featured book's own SERIES (in series order) when it belongs to one, else the newest releases. so a late installment still makes the cut. */}} {{ $design := $site.design | default dict }} {{ $pool := sort hugo.Data.books.books "publication_date" "desc" }} {{ with $featured }} {{ with $featured.slug) }}{{ $feat = . }}{{ else }}{{ $rest = $rest | append . }}{{ end }} {{ end }} {{ $fan := first 4 $pool }} {{ if $feat }} {{ $ordered := slice }} {{ if eq ((index $design "hero_many") |
